title: Free Claude Skill Cuts Your AI Coding Bill in Half😯
description:
Every time Claude touches your codebase, your file count grows and your bill climbs. Ask for a simple date picker and it might install a library, build a wrapper component, write a stylesheet, and open a debate about time zones — 50 lines for something that needed one.

A free skill called Ponytail fixes that. It's already at 111,000+ GitHub stars and thousands of forks. It makes your AI coding agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room — the one who's been there longer than your version control. Show him 50 lines, he says nothing, and hands back one.
